text:
Type: scented candle in a lidded glass jar
Use: soft candlelight and fragrance on a coffee table, a shelf or a bedside; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: clear molded glass jar with a ribbed shoulder, matching glass lid, pink wax, single cotton wick
Colors: soft pink, clear glass
Shape: short round jar with a rounded shoulder and a thick heavy base, flat glass lid with concentric rings, small and squat
Feel: soft, cozy, romantic, calm
Goes with: pastel textiles, white or light wood surfaces, brass or glass accents; cozy living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: LUGGA
product.description: Creates atmosphere with a pleasant scent of blossoming romance and warm candlelight.
